caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a rounded backrest composed of six thin vertical spindles connected to a semicircular top rail. The seat is flat and slightly curved at the edges. The chair has four legs that are turned and slightly splayed outward, connected by two horizontal stretchers, with one stretcher in front and another connecting the side legs. The wood is shown in shades of brown with subtle variations, giving the impression of wood grain and a polished surface. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present. The chair is centered in the composition, occupying most of the vertical space in the drawing.
title: Windsor Chair
